description: How should traffic be split next between price variants? Send the trials and conversions of two to ten variants and get each one's share of the next traffic by Thompson sampling: its chance of being best, with a floor so none is starved (min_weight). Exact by default; in Monte Carlo mode it samples draws times, reproducibly for a given seed. Billed as one call to the allocator function. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

draws.description: Monte Carlo mode only: how many samples.

min_weight.description: The least share any variant gets.

mode.description: Exact (the default) or Monte Carlo sampling.

prior.description: Beta prior on the conversion rate. Defaults to a flat prior.

seed.description: Monte Carlo mode only: makes the answer repeatable.

variants.description: Two to ten variants, each with a unique id, its trials and its conversions (never more than trials).

id.description: A name for the variant, unique in the list.

trials.description: How many times it was shown.

name: allocate_variant_traffic
